description: Live English-site route paths used by the container redirect-target lint. The production sitemap is the truth for CURRENT-channel targets; a redirect may only target a page that is already published.
refresh: curl -s https://docs.zilliz.com/sitemap.xml | grep -o '<loc>[^<]*</loc>' | sed 's|<loc>https://docs.zilliz.com||; s|</loc>||' | sort -u
